title: SM City Cebu welcomes Christmas with a celestial celebration

blocks.text: SM City Cebu ushered in the 2026 holiday season on October 24, 2026 with the launch of A Celestial Christmas, featuring a 30-foot Christmas tree, cosmic-inspired decorations, and a fashion showcase by Cebuano designer John Luman-ag. The celebration brings together festive displays, local creativity, and opportunities for families to make memories, while highlighting how Christmas traditions can also support Cebuano talent and community giving. A celestial celebration with a Cebuano touch Inspired by the beauty of the cosmos, the centerpiece features a 30-foot Christmas tree adorned with crystal-inspired ornaments, crescent moons, and celestial accents in blue and teal.
